footprint_geometry.note: 6 of 2047 cached records fell outside the UTM lattice and were dropped

height_m.rule: height_roof (roof height above ground); ground_elevation is not subtracted from the reported value

road_width.rule: width tag, else lanes x 3.5 m, else class default

pm25_ugm3.note: CAMS ~11 km model field, 24 h mean in America/New_York local time; not an observation

no2_ugm3.note: CAMS ~11 km model field, 24 h mean

lst_day_c.note: NASA POWER TS, 0.5x0.625 deg (~55 km) grid point, daily mean with no day/night split; uniform across the 3x3 grid

lst_night_c.reason: no night split in POWER TS; MODIS needs Earthdata credentials

energy_kwh_m2_day.note: Stewart & Oke (2012) Table 4 Q_F midpoint, W/m2 of ground area; total anthropogenic heat, not building-only EUI

lcz.rule: lambda_p, area-weighted height and median height

notes: Air-quality days are resolved in America/New_York, matching the other two cases.
LST, energy and air quality are proxies, not observations; see baseline_provenance.csv.
